documents.name: Customer Email
documents.content:
Dear Customer Support Team,

I am writing to formally report an issue with my Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
(Model: SM-S938B), purchased on 30 March 2026.

My Customer ID is CUST10003.

*Issue Description:*
Since the last week of March 2026, I have experienced frequent WiFi
connectivity drops on my device. The phone disconnects from the network
intermittently every few hours and requires manual reconnection each time.

I have already attempted the following troubleshooting steps:

   - Restarted both the router and the device
   - Forgotten and reconnected to the WiFi network
   - Reset the network settings on the device

Despite these efforts, the issue persists and is impacting my daily work,
as I depend heavily on a stable internet connection.

*Requested Resolution:*
Given that the device is within the 12-month warranty period, I request a
thorough inspection and necessary repair or resolution, as this appears to
be a hardware or firmware-related issue.

I have attached a copy of the purchase invoice for your reference.

Kindly acknowledge receipt of this complaint and guide me on the next steps
at the earliest.

Thank you for your support.

Sincerely,
Pranay Nath
Customer ID: CUST10003
Phone: +91-97654-32109
Email: pranay15nath@gmail.com
City: Pune, Maharashtra

autoEmailResponse.body:
Dear Pranay Nath,

We have good news regarding your complaint (Reference: CMP-ING-1775108870573-c1276d8) about your
Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra.

After reviewing the details of your case, we are pleased to confirm that your
complaint has been approved and we will be arranging a repair for you.

What happens next:
  1. Our technical team will contact you within 48 hours to arrange the repair.
  2. Please have your product and proof of purchase ready.
  3. If a courier collection is required, we will arrange this at no cost to you.

Please keep this email for your records and quote your reference number
(CMP-ING-1775108870573-c1276d8) in any future correspondence.

If you have any questions at any point during this process, our team is here to help:
  Email: support@electronics.com
  Phone: 1-800-ELEC-HELP  (Monday – Friday, 9am – 6pm)

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We are sorry for the inconvenience
caused and look forward to getting this resolved for you promptly.

Kind regards,
Customer Support Team
Consumer Electronics
